You: In proxmox, how to tell a VM alread:
To start a VM from the virtual disk again in Proxmox, you can follow these steps:

1. Go to the Proxmox web interface and log in.
2. Click on the "Nodes" tab and select the node where your VM is located.
3. Click on the "VMs" tab and select the VM that you want to start from the virtual disk again.
4. Click on the "Actions" dropdown menu and select "Start".
5. In the "Start" dialog box, make sure that the "Boot order" is set to "Hard Disk 1" (which is your virtual disk).
6. Click "OK" to start the VM.

Please note that you need to have the correct permissions to start a VM in Proxmox.

- https://pve.proxmox.com/wiki/Start_a_VM
